sample: Exact frozen 60 stage-09 puzzle positions; reused for a paired exploratory extension, not an independent confirmatory sample.
outcome: Assisted exact official first move, same FEN, piece list, legal choices, prompt and whole-answer legal UCI/canonical SAN scoring as GPT-OSS.
capability_gate: Eight synthetic fixtures: all completed and usable; both side checks, both legal checks, at least two of four mate-in-one checks correct. Stop after two consecutive infrastructure or generation-limit failures.
analysis_gate: All 60 cases attempted; at least 58 completed provider responses and at least 15 successes and 15 failures. Same early analysis rule as stage 10.
regression: Separate binomial GLM per deployment: success ~ (rating-1500)/500 + multiple-solver-moves indicator; 95% model-based intervals.
tree: Separate descriptive numeric CART per deployment: depth 2, min leaf 10, rating/solver-move count/legal-move count. No held-out accuracy claims.
retry: Identical requests only on transport/429/5xx; never retry incorrect, malformed, blocked or length-limited model outcomes. Daily/zero quota or server wait >120s pauses that provider. Five attempts maximum.
interpretation: These are deployments with documented model-specific temperatures and reasoning settings. A label of low is not an equal compute budget across providers. Shared puzzles imply paired outcomes; no pooled independent-row significance test or causal family/size claim.
